cases.refreshed: Join us for music, stories, and joyful play at this storytime perfect for families with young children. Music and movement help our littlest learners develop their communication skills, their imagination, and their connection with the loving grown-ups in their lives. Let's sing! Free, with limited capacity. Vehicle parking may be limited. Space to park strollers outside the Children's Room is limited. Please leave strollers outside during storytime. Sensory Notes: - Sound: This storytime will be noisy with singing, instruments, and pre-recorded music. Let the librarian know before storytime begins if you would like to borrow a pair of ear defenders for your child. - Visuals: This storytime is usually very busy with lots of families moving around. - Texture: This storytime sometimes includes the use of soft scarves, weighted beanbags, and other textured items. Children are always free to skip these activities if they prefer. Need a social story? Email charlie.roos@lib.sccgov.org to request a digital social story to help your child feel prepared for storytime. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: ¿Buscas apoyo para avanzar en tu carrera? ¡Estamos aquí para ayudarte! Ofrecemos asistencia gratuita con las siguientes tareas. Creación de un currículum y una carta de presentación - Destaca tus habilidades y experiencia con documentos profesionales que abran puertas. Búsqueda de oportunidades de empleo - Te guiamos para encontrar vacantes en los principales sitios web de trabajo. Llenado de formularios de solicitud - Incluye ayuda con la verificación del historial laboral y otros documentos esenciales para tu contratación. Técnicas y consejos para entrevistas - Aprende cómo responder con confianza, qué decir, qué evitar y cómo causar una excelente impresión. Práctica para el examen escrito de manejo - Prepárate con materiales y preguntas de práctica para aprobar tu examen.
cases.reviewed: ¿Buscas apoyo para avanzar en tu carrera? ¡Estamos aquí para ayudarte! Ofrecemos asistencia gratuita para preparar un currículum y una carta de presentación que destaquen tus habilidades y experiencia. Te guiamos para encontrar vacantes en los principales sitios web de trabajo. Te ayudamos a completar solicitudes, verificar tu historial laboral y preparar otros documentos esenciales para tu contratación. Recibe consejos para responder con confianza en las entrevistas y saber qué decir, qué evitar y cómo causar una excelente impresión. Prepárate para el examen escrito de manejo con materiales y preguntas de práctica.

cases.refreshed: It's Wonderful Winter time with Little Explorers! We may not have snow, but we can still play in a wintery way, with a variety of snowy-themed crafts and play activities. Little Explorers is a monthly creativity-based program for families with toddlers and preschoolers. Join us on the first Friday of the month to explore new ways to play and learn! Free, with limited capacity. Vehicle parking may be limited. A small number of strollers may be parked outside the Children's Room; no strollers in the Community Room, please. Sensory Notes: - Sound: Little Explorers can often be noisy with the sounds of play, as well as background music. Let the librarian know if you would like to borrow a pair of ear defenders for your child. - Visuals: Little Explorers may be visually busy with kids at different activity stations, using bright colors and craft supplies. - Texture: Different stations at Little Explorers may include wet or sticky textures as part of a craft or activity. Children are always free to skip these activities if they prefer. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
